description.value: Super Stars Cafe is a Hong Kong-style Chinese, Asian, and Thai restaurant with two Metro Vancouver locations, the Richmond outpost occupying a unit in a commercial plaza on Leslie Road. The menu leans toward Cantonese comfort food — baked pork chop rice, Portuguese beef brisket, dry-fried beef ho fun — alongside dim sum and Thai options. Online ordering with a 15-minute pickup window makes it a practical stop for cyclists passing through Richmond's food-heavy commercial corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Super Stars Cafe as a restaurant at 8080 Leslie Rd #110, Richmond; the website fully corroborates the address and provides a phone number (+1 604-248-1293) not present in OSM. The website confirms online ordering with a 15-minute pickup option, establishing takeout capability, but contains no evidence for bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities. The business appears actively operating with two Metro Vancouver locations and a functional online ordering system.
